([[West Chester, Pennsylvania]]) | college = [[Duke Blue Devils men's basketball|Duke]] (2022–present) | highlights = * [[Atlantic Coast Conference|ACC]] All-Defensive team (2023) * ACC All-Freshman team (2023) * [[McDonald's All-American Game|McDonald's All-American]] ([[2022 McDonald's All-American Boys Game|2022]]) * [[Jordan Brand Classic]] (2022) * [[Nike Hoop Summit]] (2022) }} '''Dereck Jerome Lively II''' (born February 12, 2004) is an American [[college basketball]] player for the [[Duke Blue Devils men's basketball|Duke Blue Devils]] of the [[Atlantic Coast Conference]] (ACC). He was a consensus five-star [[college recruiting|recruit]] and one of the top players in the 2022 class. ==High school career== Lively attended [[Westtown School]] in [[West Chester, Pennsylvania]].{{Cite web|url=https://www.inquirer.com/sports/dereck-lively-ii-westtown-duke-nba-draft-20220225.html|title = Dereck Lively II could become the best player Westtown has produced}}{{Cite web|url=https://www.slamonline.com/the-magazine/dereck-lively-duke-slam-236/|title = No.1 Senior Dereck Lively is Ready to Reach for New Heights at Duke|date = 28 February 2022}} He was selected to play in the [[2022 McDonald's All-American Boys Game]].{{Cite web|url=https://www.si.com/college/duke/basketball/jon-scheyer-three-mcdonalds-all-americans|title=Three Jon Scheyer Recruits Named McDonald's All-Americans}}{{Cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/33145674/duke-men-basketball-prospect-dereck-lively-headlines-star-studded-roster-mcdonald-all-american-game|title = Lively headlines McDonald's All American roster|date = 25 January 2022}} ===Recruiting=== Lively is a consensus five-star [[college recruiting|recruit]] and one of the top players in the 2022 class, according to major recruiting services. On September 20, 2021, he committed to playing college basketball for [[Duke Blue Devils men's basketball|Duke]] over offers from [[Kentucky Wildcats men's basketball|Kentucky]], [[Michigan Wolverines men's basketball|Michigan]] and [[Penn State Nittany Lions basketball|Penn State]].{{Cite
